transcript.final_yaml:
collection: 00 - FSR Studio
playbooks:
- name: Outbound C2 Triage - FortiSIEM IP and Host Pivot
  trigger: start
  is_active: true
  steps:
  - type: start
    name: Start
    next: Set Inputs
    module: alerts
  - type: set_variable
    name: Set Inputs
    vars:
      src_ip: '{{ vars.input.records[0].sourceIp }}'
      dst_ip: '{{ vars.input.records[0].destinationIp }}'
    next: siem_search src
  - type: connector
    name: siem_search src
    connector: connector-fsr-soc-assistant
    operation: call_mcp_tool
    tool: siem_search
    args:
      by: ip
      value: '{{ vars.steps.Set_Inputs.src_ip }}'
      direction: src
      window: 30d
    next: siem_search dst
  - type: connector
    name: siem_search dst
    connector: connector-fsr-soc-assistant
    operation: call_mcp_tool
    tool: siem_search
    args:
      by: ip
      value: '{{ vars.steps.Set_Inputs.dst_ip }}'
      direction: dst
      window: 30d
    next: edr_host
  - type: connector
    name: edr_host
    connector: connector-fsr-soc-assistant
    operation: call_mcp_tool
    tool: edr_host
    args:
      ip: '{{ vars.steps.Set_Inputs.src_ip }}'
      window: 90d
    next: End
  - type: end
    name: End
transcript.summary: Pure triage playbook for alerts from FortiSIEM. It reads the alert's sourceIp and destinationIp, runs FortiSIEM searches for the source IP (outbound) and destination IP (inbound) over 30 days, and runs an EDR host lookup on the source IP over 90 days. It makes no changes and does not write a verdict to the record. The investigation so far found no matching FortiSIEM events or EDR host records, so this playbook encodes the checks, not a conclusion. The host name 'smithDesktop' is not an alert field, so the EDR step looks up by IP only.
